data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ب-ش-ر (b-sh-r), 'to give good news'. Bushrā means 'good news'. Its root is ب-ش-ر (b-sh-r). A Qur'anic term; a common Muslim name. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bushra total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
